verses.original: בְּרֵאשִׁ֖ית בָּרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֵ֥ת הַשָּׁמַ֖יִם וְאֵ֥ת הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·rê·šîṯ bā·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’êṯ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’êṯ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth
verses.literalPt: NO princípio criou Deus os céus e a terra.

verses.original: וְהָאָ֗רֶץ הָיְתָ֥ה תֹ֙הוּ֙ וָבֹ֔הוּ וְחֹ֖שֶׁךְ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י תְה֑וֹם וְר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֔ים מְרַחֶ֖פֶת עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ā·reṣ hā·yə·ṯāh ṯō·hū wā·ḇō·hū wə·ḥō·šeḵ ‘al- pə·nê ṯə·hō·wm wə·rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm mə·ra·ḥe·p̄eṯ ‘al- pə·nê ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: Now the earth was formless and void and darkness was over the surface of the deep And the Spirit of God was hovering over the surface of the waters
verses.literalPt: E a terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus se movia sobre a face das águas.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֖ים יְהִ֣י א֑וֹר וַֽיְהִי־ אֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·hî ’ō·wr way·hî- ’ō·wr
verses.literal: And God said Let there be light and there was light
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Haja luz; e houve luz.

verses.original: וַיַּ֧רְא אֱלֹהִ֛ים אֶת־ הָא֖וֹר כִּי־ ט֑וֹב וַיַּבְדֵּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֔ים בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֥ין הַחֹֽשֶׁךְ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ō·wr kî- ṭō·wḇ way·yaḇ·dêl ’ĕ·lō·hîm bên hā·’ō·wr ū·ḇên ha·ḥō·šeḵ
verses.literal: And God saw that the light was good and He separated the light from . . . the darkness
verses.literalPt: E viu Deus que era boa a luz; e fez Deus separação entre a luz e as trevas.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לָאוֹר֙ י֔וֹם וְלַחֹ֖שֶׁךְ קָ֣רָא לָ֑יְלָה וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם אֶחָֽד׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·’ō·wr yō·wm wə·la·ḥō·šeḵ qā·rā lā·yə·lāh way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: God called the light day and the darkness He called night And there was evening and there was morning the first day
verses.literalPt: E Deus chamou à luz Dia; e às trevas chamou Noite. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia primeiro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יְהִ֥י רָקִ֖יעַ בְּת֣וֹךְ הַמָּ֑יִם וִיהִ֣י מַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין מַ֖יִם לָמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·hî rā·qî·a‘ bə·ṯō·wḵ ham·mā·yim wî·hî maḇ·dîl bên ma·yim lā·mā·yim
verses.literal: And God said Let there be an expanse between the waters to separate . . . the waters from the waters
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Haja uma expansão no meio das águas, e haja separação entre águas e águas.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֮ אֶת־ הָרָקִיעַ֒ וַיַּבְדֵּ֗ל בֵּ֤ין הַמַּ֙יִם֙ אֲשֶׁר֙ מִתַּ֣חַת לָרָקִ֔יעַ וּבֵ֣ין הַמַּ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעַ֣ל לָרָקִ֑יעַ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·rā·qî·a‘ way·yaḇ·dêl bên ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer mit·ta·ḥaṯ lā·rā·qî·a‘ ū·ḇên ham·ma·yim ’ă·šer mê·‘al lā·rā·qî·a‘ way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: So God made the expanse and separated . . . the waters beneath it from the waters above And it was so
verses.literalPt: E fez Deus a expansão, e fez separação entre as águas que estavam debaixo da expansão e as águas que estavam sobre a expansão; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֧א אֱלֹהִ֛ים לָֽרָקִ֖יעַ שָׁמָ֑יִם וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שֵׁנִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lā·rā·qî·a‘ šā·mā·yim way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm šê·nî
verses.literal: God called the expanse sky And there was evening and there was morning the second day
verses.literalPt: E chamou Deus à expansão Céus, e foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia segundo.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יִקָּו֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם מִתַּ֤חַת הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ אֶל־ מָק֣וֹם אֶחָ֔ד וְתֵרָאֶ֖ה הַיַּבָּשָׁ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yiq·qā·wū ham·ma·yim mit·ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ma·yim ’el- mā·qō·wm ’e·ḥāḏ wə·ṯê·rā·’eh hay·yab·bā·šāh way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: And God said Let the waters under the sky be gathered into one place so that the dry land may appear And it was so
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Ajuntem-se as águas debaixo dos céus num lugar; e apareça a porção seca; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַיִּקְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ לַיַּבָּשָׁה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ וּלְמִקְוֵ֥ה הַמַּ֖יִם קָרָ֣א יַמִּ֑ים וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm lay·yab·bā·šāh ’e·reṣ ū·lə·miq·wêh ham·ma·yim qā·rā yam·mîm way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: God called the dry land earth and the gathering of waters He called seas And God saw that it was good
verses.literalPt: E chamou Deus à porção seca Terra; e ao ajuntamento das águas chamou Mares; e viu Deus que era bom.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תַּֽדְשֵׁ֤א הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ דֶּ֔שֶׁא עֵ֚שֶׂב מַזְרִ֣יעַ זֶ֔רַע עֵ֣ץ פְּרִ֞י עֹ֤שֶׂה פְּרִי֙ לְמִינ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm taḏ·šê hā·’ā·reṣ de·še ‘ê·śeḇ maz·rî·a‘ ze·ra‘ ‘êṣ pə·rî ‘ō·śeh pə·rî lə·mî·nōw ’ă·šer zar·‘ōw- ḇōw ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: Then God said Let the earth bring forth vegetation seed-bearing . . . plants and fruit trees each bearing fruit with seed according to its kind - - And it was so
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra erva verde, erva que dê semente, árvore frutífera que dê fruto segundo a sua espécie, cuja semente está nela sobre a terra; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַתּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ דֶּ֠שֶׁא עֵ֣שֶׂב מַזְרִ֤יעַ זֶ֙רַע֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וְעֵ֧ץ עֹֽשֶׂה־ פְּרִ֛י אֲשֶׁ֥ר זַרְעוֹ־ ב֖וֹ לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tō·w·ṣê hā·’ā·reṣ de·še ‘ê·śeḇ maz·rî·a‘ ze·ra‘ lə·mî·nê·hū wə·‘êṣ ‘ō·śeh- pə·rî ’ă·šer zar·‘ōw- ḇōw lə·mî·nê·hū way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: The earth produced vegetation seed-bearing . . . plants according to their kinds and trees bearing fruit with seed . . . according to their kinds And God saw that it was good
verses.literalPt: E a terra produziu erva, erva dando semente conforme a sua espécie, e a árvore frutífera, cuja semente está nela conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם שְׁלִישִֽׁי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm šə·lî·šî
verses.literal: And there was evening and there was morning the third day
verses.literalPt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia terceiro.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים יְהִ֤י מְאֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהַבְדִּ֕יל בֵּ֥ין הַיּ֖וֹם וּבֵ֣ין הַלָּ֑יְלָה וְהָי֤וּ לְאֹתֹת֙ וּלְמ֣וֹעֲדִ֔ים וּלְיָמִ֖ים וְשָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yə·hî mə·’ō·rōṯ bir·qî·a‘ haš·šā·ma·yim lə·haḇ·dîl bên hay·yō·wm ū·ḇên hal·lā·yə·lāh wə·hā·yū lə·’ō·ṯōṯ ū·lə·mō·w·‘ă·ḏîm ū·lə·yā·mîm wə·šā·nîm
verses.literal: And God said Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to distinguish between the day and the night and let them be signs to mark the seasons and days and years
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Haja luminares na expansão dos céus, para haver separação entre o dia e a noite; e sejam eles para sinais e para tempos determinados e para dias e anos.

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ לִמְאוֹרֹת֙ בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū lim·’ō·w·rōṯ bir·qî·a‘ haš·šā·ma·yim lə·hā·’îr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: And let them serve as lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth And it was so
verses.literalPt: E sejam para luminares na expansão dos céus, para iluminar a terra; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ שְׁנֵ֥י הַמְּאֹרֹ֖ת הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים אֶת־ הַמָּא֤וֹר הַגָּדֹל֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַיּ֔וֹם וְאֶת־ הַמָּא֤וֹר הַקָּטֹן֙ לְמֶמְשֶׁ֣לֶת הַלַּ֔יְלָה וְאֵ֖ת הַכּוֹכָבִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- šə·nê ham·mə·’ō·rōṯ hag·gə·ḏō·lîm ’eṯ- ham·mā·’ō·wr hag·gā·ḏōl lə·mem·še·leṯ hay·yō·wm wə·’eṯ- ham·mā·’ō·wr haq·qā·ṭōn lə·mem·še·leṯ hal·lay·lāh wə·’êṯ hak·kō·w·ḵā·ḇîm
verses.literal: God made two great lights the greater light to rule the day and the lesser light to rule the night And He made the stars as well
verses.literalPt: E fez Deus os dois grandes luminares: o luminar maior para governar o dia, e o luminar menor para governar a noite; e fez as estrelas.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֥ן אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בִּרְקִ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם לְהָאִ֖יר עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’ō·ṯām ’ĕ·lō·hîm bir·qî·a‘ haš·šā·mā·yim lə·hā·’îr ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: God set these lights in the expanse of the sky to shine upon the earth
verses.literalPt: E Deus os pôs na expansão dos céus para iluminar a terra,

verses.original: וְלִמְשֹׁל֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם וּבַלַּ֔יְלָה וּֽלֲהַבְדִּ֔יל בֵּ֥ין הָא֖וֹר וּבֵ֣ין הַחֹ֑שֶׁךְ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lim·šōl bay·yō·wm ū·ḇal·lay·lāh ū·lă·haḇ·dîl bên hā·’ō·wr ū·ḇên ha·ḥō·šeḵ way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: to preside over the day and the night and to separate the light from . . . the darkness And God saw that it was good
verses.literalPt: E para governar o dia e a noite, e para fazer separação entre a luz e as trevas; e viu Deus que era bom.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם רְבִיעִֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm rə·ḇî·‘î
verses.literal: And there was evening and there was morning the fourth day
verses.literalPt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quarto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים יִשְׁרְצ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם שֶׁ֖רֶץ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֑ה וְעוֹף֙ יְעוֹפֵ֣ף עַל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֖י רְקִ֥יעַ הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm yiš·rə·ṣū ham·ma·yim še·reṣ ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh wə·‘ō·wp̄ yə·‘ō·w·p̄êp̄ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê rə·qî·a‘ haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: And God said Let the waters teem with living . . . creatures and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Produzam as águas abundantemente répteis de alma vivente; e voem as aves sobre a face da expansão dos céus.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרָ֣א אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ הַתַּנִּינִ֖ם הַגְּדֹלִ֑ים וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ הַֽחַיָּ֣ה׀ הָֽרֹמֶ֡שֶׂת אֲשֶׁר֩ שָׁרְצ֨וּ הַמַּ֜יִם לְמִֽינֵהֶ֗ם וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ ע֤וֹף כָּנָף֙ לְמִינֵ֔הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hat·tan·nî·nim hag·gə·ḏō·lîm wə·’êṯ kāl- ne·p̄eš ha·ḥay·yāh hā·rō·me·śeṯ ’ă·šer šā·rə·ṣū ham·ma·yim lə·mî·nê·hem wə·’êṯ kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ kā·nāp̄ lə·mî·nê·hū way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: So God created the great sea creatures and every living thing that moves with which the waters teemed according to their kinds and every winged bird after its kind And God saw that it was good
verses.literalPt: E Deus criou as grandes baleias, e todo o réptil de alma vivente que as águas abundantemente produziram conforme as suas espécies; e toda a ave de asas conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֧רֶךְ אֹתָ֛ם אֱלֹהִ֖ים לֵאמֹ֑ר פְּר֣וּ וּרְב֗וּ וּמִלְא֤וּ אֶת־ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וְהָע֖וֹף יִ֥רֶב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯām ’ĕ·lō·hîm lê·mōr pə·rū ū·rə·ḇū ū·mil·’ū ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim bay·yam·mîm wə·hā·‘ō·wp̄ yi·reḇ bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then God blessed them and said Be fruitful and multiply and fill the waters of the seas and let birds multiply on the earth
verses.literalPt: E Deus os abençoou, dizendo: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos, e enchei as águas nos mares; e as aves se multipliquem na terra.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם חֲמִישִֽׁי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm ḥă·mî·šî
verses.literal: And there was evening and there was morning the fifth day
verses.literalPt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quinto.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים תּוֹצֵ֨א הָאָ֜רֶץ נֶ֤פֶשׁ חַיָּה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ בְּהֵמָ֥ה וָרֶ֛מֶשׂ וְחַֽיְתוֹ־ אֶ֖רֶץ לְמִינָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm tō·w·ṣê hā·’ā·reṣ ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh lə·mî·nāh bə·hê·māh wā·re·meś wə·ḥay·ṯōw- ’e·reṣ lə·mî·nāh way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: And God said Let the earth bring forth living creatures according to their kinds livestock land crawlers and beasts of the earth according to their kinds And it was so
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra alma vivente conforme a sua espécie; gado, e répteis e feras da terra conforme a sua espécie; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַיַּ֣עַשׂ אֱלֹהִים֩ אֶת־ חַיַּ֨ת הָאָ֜רֶץ לְמִינָ֗הּ וְאֶת־ הַבְּהֵמָה֙ לְמִינָ֔הּ וְאֵ֛ת כָּל־ רֶ֥מֶשׂ הָֽאֲדָמָ֖ה לְמִינֵ֑הוּ וַיַּ֥רְא אֱלֹהִ֖ים כִּי־ טֽוֹב׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- ḥay·yaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ lə·mî·nāh wə·’eṯ- hab·bə·hê·māh lə·mî·nāh wə·’êṯ kāl- re·meś hā·’ă·ḏā·māh lə·mî·nê·hū way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm kî- ṭō·wḇ
verses.literal: God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds the livestock according to their kinds and everything that crawls upon the earth according to its kind And God saw that it was good
verses.literalPt: E fez Deus as feras da terra conforme a sua espécie, e o gado conforme a sua espécie, e todo o réptil da terra conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֔ים נַֽעֲשֶׂ֥ה אָדָ֛ם בְּצַלְמֵ֖נוּ כִּדְמוּתֵ֑נוּ וְיִרְדּוּ֩ בִדְגַ֨ת הַיָּ֜ם וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֗יִם וּבַבְּהֵמָה֙ וּבְכָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבְכָל־ הָרֶ֖מֶשׂ הָֽרֹמֵ֥שׂ עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm na·‘ă·śeh ’ā·ḏām bə·ṣal·mê·nū kiḏ·mū·ṯê·nū wə·yir·dū ḇiḏ·ḡaṯ hay·yām ū·ḇə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇab·bə·hê·māh ū·ḇə·ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇə·ḵāl hā·re·meś hā·rō·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Then God said Let Us make man in Our image after Our likeness to rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air over the livestock and over all the earth itself and every creature that crawls upon it
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem, conforme a nossa semelhança; e domine sobre os peixes do mar, e sobre as aves dos céus, e sobre o gado, e sobre toda a terra, e sobre todo o réptil que se move sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיִּבְרָ֨א אֱלֹהִ֤ים׀ אֶת־ הָֽאָדָם֙ בְּצַלְמ֔וֹ בְּצֶ֥לֶם אֱלֹהִ֖ים בָּרָ֣א אֹת֑וֹ זָכָ֥ר וּנְקֵבָ֖ה בָּרָ֥א אֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḇ·rā ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- hā·’ā·ḏām bə·ṣal·mōw bə·ṣe·lem ’ĕ·lō·hîm bā·rā ’ō·ṯōw zā·ḵār ū·nə·qê·ḇāh bā·rā ’ō·ṯām
verses.literal: So God created man in His own image in the image of God He created him male and female He created them
verses.literalPt: E criou Deus o homem à sua imagem; à imagem de Deus o criou; homem e mulher os criou.

verses.original: וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹתָם֮ אֱלֹהִים֒ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לָהֶ֜ם אֱלֹהִ֗ים פְּר֥וּ וּרְב֛וּ וּמִלְא֥וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֖רֶץ וְכִבְשֻׁ֑הָ וּרְד֞וּ בִּדְגַ֤ת הַיָּם֙ וּבְע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וּבְכָל־ חַיָּ֖ה הָֽרֹמֶ֥שֶׂת עַל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇā·reḵ ’ō·ṯām ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yō·mer lā·hem ’ĕ·lō·hîm pə·rū ū·rə·ḇū ū·mil·’ū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ wə·ḵiḇ·šu·hā ū·rə·ḏū biḏ·ḡaṯ hay·yām ū·ḇə·‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·ḇə·ḵāl ḥay·yāh hā·rō·me·śeṯ ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: God blessed them and said to them Be fruitful and multiply and fill the earth and subdue it rule over the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth
verses.literalPt: E Deus os abençoou, e Deus lhes disse: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos, e enchei a terra, e sujeitai-a; e dominai sobre os peixes do mar e sobre as aves dos céus, e sobre todo o animal que se move sobre a terra.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלֹהִ֗ים הִנֵּה֩ נָתַ֨תִּי לָכֶ֜ם אֶת־ כָּל־ עֵ֣שֶׂב׀ זֹרֵ֣עַ זֶ֗רַע אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י כָל־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ הָעֵ֛ץ אֲשֶׁר־ בּ֥וֹ פְרִי־ עֵ֖ץ זֹרֵ֣עַ זָ֑רַע לָכֶ֥ם יִֽהְיֶ֖ה לְאָכְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lō·hîm hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî lā·ḵem ’eṯ- kāl- ‘ê·śeḇ zō·rê·a‘ ze·ra‘ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê ḵāl hā·’ā·reṣ wə·’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘êṣ ’ă·šer- bōw p̄ə·rî- ‘êṣ zō·rê·a‘ zā·ra‘ lā·ḵem yih·yeh lə·’āḵ·lāh
verses.literal: Then God said Behold I have given you every seed-bearing plant on the face of all the earth and every tree whose fruit contains . . . seed They will be yours for food
verses.literalPt: E disse Deus: Eis que vos tenho dado toda a erva que dê semente, que está sobre a face de toda a terra; e toda a árvore, em que há fruto que dê semente, ser-vos-á para mantimento.

verses.original: וּֽלְכָל־ חַיַּ֣ת הָ֠אָרֶץ וּלְכָל־ ע֨וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֜יִם וּלְכֹ֣ל׀ רוֹמֵ֣שׂ עַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר־ בּוֹ֙ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֔ה אֶת־ כָּל־ יֶ֥רֶק עֵ֖שֶׂב לְאָכְלָ֑ה וַֽיְהִי־ כֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·lə·ḵāl- ḥay·yaṯ hā·’ā·reṣ ū·lə·ḵāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim ū·lə·ḵōl rō·w·mêś ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer- bōw ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh ’eṯ- kāl- ye·req ‘ê·śeḇ lə·’āḵ·lāh way·hî- ḵên
verses.literal: And to every beast of the earth and every bird of the air and every creature that crawls upon the earth everything that has the breath of life in it I have given every green plant for food And it was so
verses.literalPt: E a todo o animal da terra, e a toda a ave dos céus, e a todo o réptil da terra, em que há alma vivente, toda a erva verde será para mantimento; e assim foi.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤רְא אֱלֹהִים֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשָׂ֔ה וְהִנֵּה־ ט֖וֹב מְאֹ֑ד וַֽיְהִי־ עֶ֥רֶב וַֽיְהִי־ בֹ֖קֶר י֥וֹם הַשִּׁשִּֽׁי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’eṯ- kāl- ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh wə·hin·nêh- ṭō·wḇ mə·’ōḏ way·hî- ‘e·reḇ way·hî- ḇō·qer yō·wm haš·šiš·šî
verses.literal: And God looked upon all that He had made and indeed it was very good And there was evening and there was morning the sixth day
verses.literalPt: E viu Deus tudo quanto tinha feito, e eis que era muito bom; e foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia sexto.
